description: Use when an agent needs to know if an npm or PyPI version has a published advisory. Returns flagged (any OSV advisory for that exact version), highest severity, advisories, release, scripts, downloads, name-squat flags. 404 or 503: not charged. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

name.description: package name: an npm name (optionally @scope/name) or a PyPI project name

version.description: version to check, for example 4.17.21 (default: the latest published version)
